Name: Chefs Closet
Author: FreddyFugazi
Description:
[b]What[/b]
Improve the cooking experience by giving the user the ability to include items from chests in the cooking menu, in addition to the fridge items.

[b]How[/b]
In order for a chest's inventory to be included in the cooking menu it must be placed in the kitchen.

[b]Why[/b]
Extending the fridge itself to hold more items is a common suggestion [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/extended-fridge-smapi.117348/]and also viable[/url], but it improves the cooking experience at the expense of item management and organisation. By allowing you to store cooking items across a number of chests you can better organize your ingredients while still having access to them all for cooking.

Supports SMAPI 1.8+

Downloads.Description: Make more items available during cooking by placing chests in the kitchen.
